none-in-range: A tile's note or a row's numbers when nothing happened in the dashboard's time range.
no-turns: In place of the Tokens card's list on the Health page when there were no turns (answers from a socio, an AI agent) in the chosen range.
not-recorded: Shown in place of a model's name when it wasn't recorded.
in-range: How many goals were done (or canceled) in the time range.
latency.title: Card title on the Health page of the Operations dashboard: how long people wait.
latency.description: "p95": the 95th percentile; keep it as is.
latency.stats: Accessible name of the group of latency tiles.
latency.first-output: Tile: how long a model took to start answering, at the 95th percentile (p95; keep as is).
latency.tools: Tile: how long tool calls took, at the 95th percentile (p95; keep as is).
latency.turn-queue: Tile: how long a message waited before its turn started, at the 95th percentile (p95; keep as is).
latency.job-wait: Tile: how long jobs waited in the queue before running, at the 95th percentile (p95; keep as is).
latency.job-wake: Tile: how long a socio's computer took to wake up for a job.
latency.schedule-late: Tile: how late scheduled runs started.
latency.spread.rounds: Each latency.spread.*: a tile's note: the median ({{p50}}, a duration) and how many {{count}} rounds (model calls), calls, turns or runs were timed. Keep p50 as is.
latency.spread.calls: Tile note: {{p50}} the median duration, then how many tool calls were timed. Keep p50 as is.
latency.spread.turns: Tile note: {{p50}} the median duration, then how many turns were timed. Keep p50 as is.
latency.spread.runs: Tile note: {{p50}} the median duration, then how many runs were timed. Keep p50 as is.
latency.metric.first_output: Each latency.metric.*: a choice in the chart menu and the chart's title.
latency.metric.tool_duration: Chart menu choice and chart title: how long tool calls took.
latency.metric.turn_queue: Chart menu choice and chart title: how long messages waited before their turn started.
latency.metric.job_wait: Chart menu choice and chart title: how long jobs waited in the queue.
latency.metric.schedule_late: Chart menu choice and chart title: how late scheduled runs started.
latency.chart-title: Chart title: {{metric}} is one of latency.metric.*, at the 95th percentile.
latency.chart: Accessible name of the menu that picks what the latency chart shows.
latency.y: What the chart's values are, in a sentence for screen readers. Lowercase.
latency.empty: In place of the Latency and queues card's content when nothing was timed in the chosen range.
latency.by-model: Heading of the list of AI models by how long they take to start answering.
latency.by-model-empty: In place of the First output by model list when no model call was timed in the range. "Rounds": single calls to an AI model within a turn.
latency.tools-title: Heading of the list of tools by how long their calls take.
latency.tools-label: Accessible name of the list of tools and how long their calls take.
latency.tools-empty: In place of the Tools list of the Latency and queues card when no tool was called in the range.
latency.row: A row's numbers: {{p50}} the median and {{p95}} the slow end (durations), {{n}} how many were timed. Keep p50 and p95 as is.
latency.row-failed: How many of a tool's calls failed.
tokens.title: Card title, and the accessible name of its menu. "Tokens": units an AI model counts text in.
tokens.description: Description under the Tokens card title: the list shows who or what used the most tokens (units an AI model counts text in), grouped as the menu picks.
tokens.view.model: Each tokens.view.*: a menu choice for how to group the token list. "Socio" is a product noun (an AI agent).
tokens.view.socio: Menu choice: group the token list by socio (AI agent).
tokens.view.person: Menu choice: group the token list by person.
tokens.view.reasoning: Menu choice: group the token list by the kind of reasoning the model shows.
tokens.list.model: Each tokens.list.*: the accessible name of the token list, grouped as the matching tokens.view.*.
tokens.list.socio: Accessible name of the token list grouped by socio.
tokens.list.person: Accessible name of the token list grouped by person.
tokens.list.reasoning: Accessible name of the token list grouped by reasoning kind.
tokens.reasoning.summary: Each tokens.reasoning.*: a kind of reasoning a model shows (a summary of its thinking, the raw thinking, hidden, none, a mix, unknown).
tokens.reasoning.raw: Reasoning kind: the model shows its raw thinking.
tokens.reasoning.hidden: Reasoning kind: the model thinks but hides it.
tokens.reasoning.none: Reasoning kind: the model doesn't reason.
tokens.reasoning.mixed: Reasoning kind: the turn had more than one kind.
tokens.not-reported: In a reasoning kind's row: the models didn't report reasoning tokens apart. Lowercase, it follows other numbers.
tokens.reasoning-note: Note above the token list when it is grouped by reasoning kind (summary, raw...). "Output": the model's output tokens.
schedules.title: Card title: socios' schedules (tasks that run at set times) and goals (what a socio works toward over time).
schedules.description: Description under the Schedules and goals card title. "Came due": reached the time it was set to run.
schedules.stats: Accessible name of the group of schedule tiles.
schedules.failing-note: Note under the Failing tile: what counts as failing.
schedules.overdue-note: Note under the Overdue tile: what counts as overdue.
schedules.on-time: Note under the Paused tile: how many schedules are on time.
schedules.runs: Tile: how many scheduled runs happened in the chosen range.
schedules.runs-note: How many runs failed and how many started late.
schedules.goals: Accessible name of the group of goal tiles.
schedules.goal.stalled: Each schedules.goal.*: a tile counting goals in that state.
schedules.goal.active: Tile: goals a socio is working toward now.
schedules.stalled-note: Note under the Goals stalled tile: what counts as stalled.
schedules.state.failing: Each schedules.state.*: a schedule's state, as a badge (and as tile titles).
schedules.state.paused: Schedule state, as a badge and a tile title: it is paused.
schedules.state.overdue: Schedule state, as a badge and a tile title: it is due but hasn't started.
schedules.state.ok: Schedule state, as a badge: it runs on time.
schedules.state.stopped: Schedule state, as a badge: it no longer runs.
schedules.need-look: Heading of the list of schedules that need an admin's attention.
schedules.need-look-label: Accessible name of the list under the Need a look heading.
schedules.all-on-time: In place of the Need a look list when no schedule is failing, paused or overdue.
schedules.untitled: In place of the title of a schedule that has none.
schedules.changed: When the schedule last changed; {{when}} is a date and time.
schedules.late-runs: Heading of the list of scheduled runs that started late or failed.
schedules.late-runs-empty: In place of the Late or failed runs list when no scheduled run started late or failed in the range.
schedules.removed: Stands in for the title of a schedule that was deleted.
schedules.interrupted: Badge on a scheduled run that was cut off before it finished.
long-runs.title: Card title: jobs, and long runs (jobs that run until done, in batches).
long-runs.description: Description under the Jobs and long runs card title. "Dead items" is the name of a tile on the card; keep the same words.
long-runs.stats: Accessible name of the group of job tiles.
long-runs.open: Tile: long runs (jobs that work through items in batches) that are running or waiting.
long-runs.waiting: How many long runs are waiting (for a person, a limit…).
long-runs.dead: Tile: items a long run set aside after its last try failed.
long-runs.dead-note: Note under the Dead items tile: it counts only long runs still open.
long-runs.finished: Tile: long runs that finished in the chosen range.
long-runs.finished-note: Note under the Finished tile: how many of them failed and how many were canceled.
long-runs.job-runs: Tile: how many times jobs ran in the chosen range.
long-runs.job-failed: Note under the Job runs tile: {{n}} is how many of those runs failed.
long-runs.list: Accessible name of the list of long runs.
long-runs.empty: In place of the Long runs list when no long run was open or changed in the chosen range.
long-runs.status.running: Each long-runs.status.*: a long run's state, as a badge.
long-runs.status.waiting: Long run state badge: it waits (for a person, a limit…).
long-runs.status.done: Long run state badge: it finished.
long-runs.status.failed: Long run state badge: it failed.
long-runs.status.cancelled: Long run state badge: it was canceled.
long-runs.items: How many of a long run's items are done and how many remain.
long-runs.dead-items: How many of a long run's items were set aside after failing.
long-runs.batches: In a long run's row: how many batches it has worked through.
long-runs.retries: In a long run's row: how many items it tried again.
long-runs.changed: When the long run last changed; {{when}} is a date and time.
coverage.title: Card title, and its list's accessible name: how much of the data records each signal.
coverage.description: Description under the Collection coverage card title: each row shows how much of the range's data records a signal. "The numbers above": the other cards of the Health page.
coverage.share: {{share}} is a percent; {{covered}} of {{total}} recorded it.
coverage.trace: Each coverage.* without -gap: a row naming what is counted. "Trace": a turn's record of what the model and tools did.
coverage.trace-gap: Each coverage.*-gap: why some data lacks the row's signal, shown when coverage is short.
coverage.firstOutput: Coverage row: model calls timed until the model started answering.
coverage.firstOutput-gap: Under the coverage row for model rounds timed to first output, when coverage is short: why some calls lack that timing.
coverage.reasoningKind: Coverage row: traced turns that record what kind of reasoning the model showed.
coverage.reasoningTokens: Coverage row: traced turns whose model reported its reasoning tokens.
coverage.reasoningTokens-gap: Under the coverage row for traced turns with reasoning tokens reported, when coverage is short: some models don't report reasoning tokens apart from output.
coverage.receivedAt: Coverage row: turns that record when their message came in, so their queue time is known.
coverage.receivedAt-gap: Under a coverage row, when coverage is short: older turns lack the time their message arrived, so queue times skip them.
coverage.trigger: Coverage row: turns that record who started them.
coverage.trigger-gap: Under a coverage row, when coverage is short: older turns didn't record who triggered them, so they count for the chat's owner.
coverage.dueAt: Coverage row: scheduled runs that record when they came due.
coverage.dueAt-gap: Under the coverage row for scheduled runs, when coverage is short: older runs lack their due time, so schedule lateness leaves them out.
